# [Implementation] - TRIAGE must never record a dismissal that never happened

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #336 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

Every block runs from the worktree root, starts with `set -e` (so a mid-block failure is never
masked when a block is run standalone), and invokes **this worktree's** build
(`node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js"`, never the `codeloop` on `PATH`, which is the repo-root build).
Sandboxes live under `$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-336-*`, are seeded with `node` heredocs, are
parsed with `node` (never a JSON-quoted shell comparison), and install a stub `gh` that exits `1`
so no block touches the network or a real PR. The two blocks that must observe a NON-zero exit
capture it with `|| CODE=$?`, which `set -e` exempts.

#### Check 1 — the new domain vocabulary exists and the dismiss side effect names `-m`

```bash
set -e
WT_ROOT="$(pwd)"
npm run build
node - "$WT_ROOT" <<'JS'
const path = require('node:path');
const d = require(path.join(process.argv[2], 'dist', 'domain'));
const need = [
  'DISMISS_OUTCOME_REFUSED',
  'NOTE_DISMISS_REFUSED_SUFFIX',
  'NOTE_DISMISS_REFUSED_NOTHING',
  'NOTE_TRIAGE_STATE_UNCHANGED',
  'NOTE_TRIAGE_REFUSAL_NO_TRANSITION',
  'NOTE_TRIAGE_DISPOSITION_REFUSED',
  'NOTE_TRIAGE_DRY_RUN_DISMISS',
  'formatTriageDispositionLine'
];
const missing = need.filter((key) => !(key in d));
if (missing.length > 0) {
  console.error('FAIL missing domain exports: ' + missing.join(', '));
  process.exit(1);
}
if (!d.TRIAGE_ACTION_SIDE_EFFECTS.dismiss.includes('-m "<notes>"')) {
  console.error('FAIL the dismiss side effect must name -m "<notes>"');
  process.exit(1);
}
const line = d.formatTriageDispositionLine(
  { prNumber: 335, action: 'dismiss', recordedAt: '2026-10-28T05:16:20.604Z', feedbackKeys: ['id:1'] },
  'status-report'
);
if (!line.includes('PR #335') || !line.includes('action=DISMISS')) {
  console.error('FAIL status-report frame: ' + line);
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log('domain vocabulary present; status frame: ' + line);
JS
```

#### Check 2 — bare `dismiss` is refused, writes nothing, and names `-m "<notes>"`

```bash
set -e
WT_ROOT="$(pwd)"
SBX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-336-refusal"
rm -rf "$SBX"
mkdir -p "$SBX/project/.agyloop/tasks" "$SBX/bin"
printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n' > "$SBX/bin/gh"
chmod +x "$SBX/bin/gh"
node - "$SBX/project/.agyloop/tasks/336.json" <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const now = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[2], JSON.stringify({
  version: '1.0.0', currentStage: 'TRIAGE', mode: 'standard', issue: 336,
  baseBranch: 'main', planDir: null, worktree: null,
  createdAt: now, updatedAt: now,
  history: [{ stage: 'TRIAGE', timestamp: now }],
  pausedAtGate: null, pausedAtTimestamp: null, totalHumanWaitMs: 0
}, null, 2));
JS
cp "$SBX/project/.agyloop/tasks/336.json" "$SBX/before.json"
CODE=0
( cd "$SBX/project" && PATH="$SBX/bin:$PATH" node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" triage dismiss --issue 336 > "$SBX/out.txt" 2>&1 ) || CODE=$?
echo "$CODE" > "$SBX/code.txt"
node - "$SBX" <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const sbx = process.argv[2];
const out = fs.readFileSync(path.join(sbx, 'out.txt'), 'utf8');
const code = Number(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sbx, 'code.txt'), 'utf8').trim());
const before = fs.readFileSync(path.join(sbx, 'before.json'), 'utf8');
const after = fs.readFileSync(path.join(sbx, 'project', '.agyloop', 'tasks', '336.json'), 'utf8');
const fail = [];
if (code === 0) fail.push('exit code was 0 (a refusal must be non-zero)');
if (!out.includes('-m "<notes>"')) fail.push('the message does not name -m "<notes>"');
if (!out.includes('DISMISS (REFUSED)')) fail.push('no DISMISS (REFUSED) line');
if (out.includes('✓ State Updated')) fail.push('a refusal printed "State Updated"');
if (before !== after) fail.push('the checkpoint was modified');
if (!after.includes('"currentStage": "TRIAGE"')) fail.push('the gate did not stay at TRIAGE');
if (fail.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL bare dismiss: ' + fail.join(' | ') + '\n' + out); process.exit(1); }
console.log('bare dismiss: refused, exit ' + code + ', -m named, checkpoint byte-identical');
JS
rm -rf "$SBX"
```

#### Check 3 — `--dry-run` without notes predicts the refusal instead of promising a dismissal

```bash
set -e
WT_ROOT="$(pwd)"
SBX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-336-dryrun"
rm -rf "$SBX"
mkdir -p "$SBX/project/.agyloop/tasks" "$SBX/bin"
printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n' > "$SBX/bin/gh"
chmod +x "$SBX/bin/gh"
node - "$SBX/project/.agyloop/tasks/336.json" <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const now = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[2], JSON.stringify({
  version: '1.0.0', currentStage: 'TRIAGE', mode: 'standard', issue: 336,
  baseBranch: 'main', planDir: null, worktree: null,
  createdAt: now, updatedAt: now,
  history: [{ stage: 'TRIAGE', timestamp: now }],
  pausedAtGate: null, pausedAtTimestamp: null, totalHumanWaitMs: 0
}, null, 2));
JS
cp "$SBX/project/.agyloop/tasks/336.json" "$SBX/before.json"
CODE=0
( cd "$SBX/project" && PATH="$SBX/bin:$PATH" node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" triage dismiss --issue 336 --dry-run > "$SBX/out.txt" 2>&1 ) || CODE=$?
echo "$CODE" > "$SBX/code.txt"
JSON_CODE=0
( cd "$SBX/project" && PATH="$SBX/bin:$PATH" node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" triage dismiss --issue 336 --dry-run --json > "$SBX/out.json" 2>/dev/null ) || JSON_CODE=$?
echo "$JSON_CODE" > "$SBX/code-json.txt"
node - "$SBX" <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const sbx = process.argv[2];
const out = fs.readFileSync(path.join(sbx, 'out.txt'), 'utf8');
const code = Number(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sbx, 'code.txt'), 'utf8').trim());
const jsonCode = Number(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sbx, 'code-json.txt'), 'utf8').trim());
const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sbx, 'out.json'), 'utf8'));
const before = fs.readFileSync(path.join(sbx, 'before.json'), 'utf8');
const after = fs.readFileSync(path.join(sbx, 'project', '.agyloop', 'tasks', '336.json'), 'utf8');
const fail = [];
if (code === 0) fail.push('the dry run exited 0 while predicting a refusal');
if (!out.includes('[dry-run]')) fail.push('the prediction is not marked [dry-run]');
if (!out.includes('DISMISS (REFUSED)')) fail.push('the prediction does not say DISMISS (REFUSED)');
if (!out.includes('-m "<notes>"')) fail.push('the prediction does not name -m "<notes>"');
if (out.includes('Would attempt a dismissal')) fail.push('a refused prediction promised an attempt');
if (jsonCode === 0) fail.push('the --json dry run exited 0');
if (payload.success !== false) fail.push('success was ' + payload.success);
if (!payload.refused || payload.refused.cause !== 'missing-notes') fail.push('refused ' + JSON.stringify(payload.refused));
if (payload.wouldDismiss !== false) fail.push('wouldDismiss was ' + payload.wouldDismiss);
if (payload.disposition !== null) fail.push('a dry run reported a disposition');
if (before !== after) fail.push('the checkpoint was modified');
if (fail.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL dry run: ' + fail.join(' | ') + '\n' + out); process.exit(1); }
console.log('dry run: refusal predicted, exit ' + code + ', nothing written');
JS
rm -rf "$SBX"
```

#### Check 5 — `status` reports the triage disposition and never denies a recorded PR

```bash
set -e
WT_ROOT="$(pwd)"
SBX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-336-status"
rm -rf "$SBX"
mkdir -p "$SBX/project/.agyloop/tasks"
node - "$SBX/project/.agyloop/tasks/336.json" <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const now = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[2], JSON.stringify({
  version: '1.0.0', currentStage: 'COMPLETED', mode: 'standard', issue: 336,
  baseBranch: 'main', planDir: null, worktree: null,
  pullRequest: null,
  triageDisposition: {
    prNumber: 335,
    action: 'dismiss',
    recordedAt: now,
    feedbackKeys: ['id:111111', 'id:222222']
  },
  createdAt: now, updatedAt: now,
  history: [{ stage: 'TRIAGE', timestamp: now }, { stage: 'COMPLETED', timestamp: now }],
  pausedAtGate: null, pausedAtTimestamp: null, totalHumanWaitMs: 0
}, null, 2));
JS
( cd "$SBX/project" && node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" status --issue 336 > "$SBX/status.txt" 2>&1 )
( cd "$SBX/project" && node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" status --json --issue 336 > "$SBX/status.json" 2>&1 )
node - "$SBX" <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const sbx = process.argv[2];
const text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(sbx, 'status.txt'), 'utf8');
const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(sbx, 'status.json'), 'utf8'));
const delivery = text.split('\n').find((line) => line.trimStart().startsWith('Delivery'));
const fail = [];
if (!delivery) fail.push('no Delivery line');
else {
  if (!delivery.includes('NOT delivered')) fail.push('Delivery: ' + delivery);
  if (!delivery.includes('PR #335')) fail.push('the Delivery line does not name the recorded PR: ' + delivery);
  if (delivery.includes('no PR recorded')) fail.push('the Delivery line denies the PR: ' + delivery);
}
if (!text.includes('Triage Disposition')) fail.push('no Triage Disposition line');
if (!text.includes('PR #335')) fail.push('the disposition line names no PR');
if (!text.includes('action=DISMISS')) fail.push('the disposition line names no action');
if (!('triageDisposition' in payload)) fail.push('status --json has no triageDisposition key');
if (!payload.triageDisposition || payload.triageDisposition.prNumber !== 335) {
  fail.push('triageDisposition ' + JSON.stringify(payload.triageDisposition));
}
if (payload.triageDisposition && payload.triageDisposition.action !== 'dismiss') {
  fail.push('triageDisposition.action ' + payload.triageDisposition.action);
}
if (payload.pullRequest !== null) fail.push('pullRequest must stay null when unrecorded');
if (fail.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL status: ' + fail.join(' | ') + '\n' + text); process.exit(1); }
console.log('status: disposition rendered, PR #335 named, JSON field present');
JS
rm -rf "$SBX"
```

```bash

const fs = require('node:fs');
const help = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8');
const fail = [];
const messageLine = help.split('\n').find((line) => line.includes('-m, --message'));
const triageLine = help.split('\n').find((line) => line.includes('triage [action]'));
if (!messageLine) fail.push('no -m, --message line');
else if (!messageLine.includes('dismissal notes')) fail.push('the -m line does not name dismissal notes');
if (!triageLine) fail.push('no triage [action] help line');
else {
  if (!triageLine.includes('-m "<notes>"')) fail.push('the triage line does not name -m "<notes>"');
  if (!triageLine.includes('dismiss')) fail.push('the triage line does not name dismiss');
}
if (fail.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL help: ' + fail.join(' | ')); process.exit(1); }
console.log('help: -m documented as the dismissal-notes flag');
JS
```

#### Check 8 — a partially failed dismissal records only what it achieved

```bash
set -e
WT_ROOT="$(pwd)"
node - "$WT_ROOT" <<'JS'
const path = require('node:path');
const dist = path.join(process.argv[2], 'dist', 'application');
const dom = require(path.join(process.argv[2], 'dist', 'domain'));
const { TriagePrCommentsUseCase } = require(dist);

async function main() {
  const sm = dom.StateMachine.createInitial({ issue: 336 });
  sm.transition(dom.STAGE_TRIAGE);
  let current = sm.toSnapshot();
  let saves = 0;
  const stateRepo = {
    load: async () => current,
    save: async (snap) => { saves += 1; current = snap; },
    exists: async () => true,
    delete: async () => {}
  };
  const gateway = {
    listReviewThreads: async () => [
      { id: 'T1', isResolved: false, commentIds: [101] },
      { id: 'T2', isResolved: false, commentIds: [202] }
    ],
    replyToThread: async (id) => { if (id === 'T2') throw new Error('secondary rate limit'); },
    resolveReviewThread: async () => {}
  };
  const useCase = new TriagePrCommentsUseCase(stateRepo, gateway);
  const result = await useCase.execute({
    issue: 336,
    prNumber: 335,
    action: 'dismiss',
    notes: 'answered inline',
    comments: [
      { id: 101, surface: 'inline', author: 'bot', body: '[error] first', category: 'error' },
      { id: 202, surface: 'inline', author: 'bot', body: '[error] second', category: 'error' }
    ]
  });
  const fail = [];
  const before = dom.StateMachine.fromSnapshot(current).triageDisposition;
  if (!result.success) fail.push('a partial dismissal must still route');
  if (result.targetStage !== dom.STAGE_COMPLETED) fail.push('stage ' + result.targetStage);
  if (!before) fail.push('no disposition recorded');
  else {
    if (!before.feedbackKeys.includes('id:101')) fail.push('the answered key is missing: ' + JSON.stringify(before.feedbackKeys));
    if (before.feedbackKeys.includes('id:202')) fail.push('the FAILED key must not be dispositioned: ' + JSON.stringify(before.feedbackKeys));
    if (before.action !== 'dismiss') fail.push('action ' + before.action);
  }
  if (saves !== 1) fail.push('saves ' + saves);
  if (fail.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL partial dismissal: ' + fail.join(' | ')); process.exit(1); }
  console.log('partial dismissal: recorded ' + JSON.stringify(before.feedbackKeys) + ', failed item left open');
}
main().catch((err) => { console.error('FAIL: ' + err.message); process.exit(1); });
JS
```

#### Check 9 — record the checkpoint shape this issue was reported against

```bash
set -e
WT_ROOT="$(pwd)"
SBX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-336-phantom"
rm -rf "$SBX"
mkdir -p "$SBX/project/.agyloop/tasks" "$SBX/bin"
printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n' > "$SBX/bin/gh"
chmod +x "$SBX/bin/gh"
node - "$SBX/project/.agyloop/tasks/336.json" <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const now = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[2], JSON.stringify({
  version: '1.0.0', currentStage: 'TRIAGE', mode: 'standard', issue: 336,
  baseBranch: 'main', planDir: null, worktree: null,
  createdAt: now, updatedAt: now,
  history: [{ stage: 'TRIAGE', timestamp: now }],
  pausedAtGate: null, pausedAtTimestamp: null, totalHumanWaitMs: 0
}, null, 2));
JS
( cd "$SBX/project" && PATH="$SBX/bin:$PATH" node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" triage dismiss --issue 336 > /dev/null 2>&1 || true )
node - "$SBX" <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const snapshot = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(process.argv[2], 'project', '.agyloop', 'tasks', '336.json'), 'utf8'));
const fail = [];
if (snapshot.currentStage !== 'TRIAGE') fail.push('stage ' + snapshot.currentStage);
// The key itself is always serialised (`triageDisposition: null`) by any save;
// what must be absent is a RECORDED disposition.
if (snapshot.triageDisposition) fail.push('a refused dismissal recorded ' + JSON.stringify(snapshot.triageDisposition));
if (!Array.isArray(snapshot.history) || snapshot.history.length !== 1) {
  fail.push('history length ' + (snapshot.history || []).length);
}
if (fail.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL phantom: ' + fail.join(' | ')); process.exit(1); }
console.log('no phantom dismissal: stage TRIAGE, no disposition, history untouched');
JS
rm -rf "$SBX"
```
